pages.text: Workhand Hoes feature toggleable Till/Harvest modes for efficient farming.

pages.title: Till Mode
pages.text: Left-click tills one tillable block (never an area). Useful for preparing single rows of farmland.

pages.title: Harvest Mode
pages.text:
Left-click harvests and replants mature crops in an area:
- Iron Workhand Hoe: 3x3 area (radius 1)
- Diamond Workhand Hoe: 5x5 area (radius 2)

An area preview is shown while aiming in Harvest mode, indicating exactly which blocks will be affected.

pages.title: Controls
pages.text:
$(bold)Right-click$(): Toggle between Till and Harvest mode (works whether or not you're aiming at a block)
$(bold)Left-click$(): Act based on current mode (till a tillable block, or harvest a mature crop/cocoa/nether wart). Left-clicking anything else breaks it normally, like any tool.

pages.title: Materials & Durability
pages.text:
Iron Workhand Hoe: 3750 durability
Diamond Workhand Hoe: 23415 durability

Both match the durability, mining speed, and enchantability of their vanilla counterparts.
